abilities.page: Pwr and Int Buff - Any St. - Ea.
lines: When in Any Stance: Power and Intelligence of all party members +7.5% \ +15% \ +22.5% \ +30% (1 turn)
* effect's power is based on number ( 1 \ 2 \ 3 \ 4 ) of Earth type moves used during the turn.
** double moves from Copy status are counted twice. Attack again moves are each counted.
** End-of-Turn, counters, knocked back or dead allies' moves are not counted.
** Counting Rules - in-length explanations
